  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD

Margo Morales, Chair  Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner
Barbara A. Pollack, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-51678  Recommendation to welcome and introduce Commissioner Johnathan “Chief”
  Coleman to the Ethics Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-51679  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, November 15, and December 13, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-51680  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation providing an update for the
  Public Records Act Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-51681  Recommendation to review the status of the Commission’s action plan and decide
  priorities as applicable to any outstanding items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  24-51682  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the 2024 Primary Nominating
  Election candidates who signed the Code of Fair Campaign Practices Pledge.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

6.  24-51683  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-51684  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on the Lobbyist Ordinance.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-51685  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Updated Policies; and, if appropriate, provide feedback to the Ad Hoc regarding
  a draft outline for a citywide ethics ordinance recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  24-51686  Recommendation to establish an Ad Hoc Committee on reviewing 2024 Candidate
  filings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 24-51687  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects;
  and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
